page.content:
Acheron — moon of the derelict and Hadley's Hope.

How LV-426 connects

  • Work: Aliens — Aliens is fought on LV-426 around Hadley's Hope.
  • Concept: Xenomorph — The derelict and later hive are on LV-426.
  • Character: Newt — Newt is a child of the LV-426 colony.

What is LV-426?

LV-426 is the barren moon where the Nostromo finds the derelict, and where Hadley's Hope later falls to a hive before Aliens arrives.

Key threads lead to Aliens, Xenomorph and Newt.
